# Make profile changes safe to recover from

## What & Why
The first build depends on browser-local storage, so profile and queue data should be protected against malformed imports and accidental edits before the app becomes a daily tool.

## Done looks like
- JSON import rejects unsupported schemas and malformed values with clear feedback.
- Exported data can round-trip back into the app without losing fields.
- CRUD actions for answers and applications persist after reload.
- The most important local-storage flows have direct regression coverage.
